answer: The only reservation a State may make to the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence is provided for in Article 33, paragraph 1. It permits a federal State to reserve the right to assume obligations under this Convention consistent with its fundamental principles governing the relationship between its central government and constituent states or other similar territorial entities. This means that the Convention shall apply to the central government of the federal State, and the federal government must inform the competent authorities of such states about the provisions of the Convention and encourage them to take appropriate action to give them effect.
